title: Tip Picker
summary: Shows tips in money on a stated base and holds back accidental huge tips, like 250 typed in the % field.
description: Tip picker that says whether the percent is on the pre- or post-tax amount (with a switch), shows each preset in money, flags a service charge already on the bill, and holds back accidental huge tips (250 in the % field, 15 as money, 100%) until fixed or confirmed.
catches: An amount typed in the percent field (250%)
A percent typed in the money field (₹15 for 15%)
A service charge already on the bill
Pre-tax vs post-tax base, stated and switchable
limits: Customs differ by country; presets and highPercent are yours to set
Rounds in the given currency; the payment system is the source of truth
a11y: Fieldset with a legend; base switch is a radiogroup
Presets are aria-pressed buttons showing money amounts
Custom input has a <label> and a hint via aria-describedby
